headword: {国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん}

definitions.explanation: Japan's basic public pension system that covers all residents aged 20-59. It is the first tier of Japan's pension system and provides a basic old-age pension.

examples.japanese: {国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: To enroll in the national pension.

examples.japanese: {国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: National pension premiums are paid every month.

examples.japanese: 20⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧になったら{国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}ら→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: You must join the national pension when you turn 20.

notes:
Japan's basic pension system covering all residents between ages 20 and 59, including foreign residents. Enrollment is mandatory. Self-employed individuals and students pay premiums directly, while company employees have their contributions handled through {厚生|こうせい}⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧ (employees' pension), which includes the national pension.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧: to enroll in the national pension
- {国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧: national pension premium
- {国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive national pension benefits
- {国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{免除|めんじょ}→免除：05764_menjo⟧: national pension exemption

JAPAN'S PENSION SYSTEM:
- {国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん} (1st tier): basic pension for all residents
- {厚生|こうせい}⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧ (2nd tier): employees' pension — additional pension for company employees and civil servants

PRACTICAL NOTE:
Foreign residents who leave Japan after paying into the system for less than 10 years may apply for a ⟦{脱退|だったい}→脱退：05770_dattai⟧{一時金|いちじきん} (lump-sum withdrawal payment).
